info.name: UltraPOS API v1
info.description:
Multi-tenant POS REST API (Laravel 12 + Passport).

Set `base_url` (e.g. http://localhost:8000) and login via the Auth folder — the access token is stored automatically in the `token` variable.

All responses use the envelope: success/message/data/meta{timestamp,request_id} and errors use error{code,details}.

request.description: Creates the tenant, assigns role:business, starts a 14-day trial and returns an access token.
Password grant. Rate limited to 5 attempts per minute.
Revoke current token and issue a new one.

item.name: Products: list (filters: search, category_id, low_stock, in_stock, sort, page)
Movements ledger (filters: product_id, type, from, to)

request.description: Totals, taxes and discounts are ALWAYS computed server-side. Cash overpayment returns change_amount.
